visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy stands in a living room, wearing a white t-shirt featuring a hamburger and French fries graphic and grey patterned shorts. He looks at the camera with a serious yet slightly bashful expression. Behind him is a grey fabric sofa adorned with various plush toys, including a large yellow Minion and other stuffed characters. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a domestic indoor setting with soft shadows on the wooden floor. (2) The boy begins practicing a dance routine in the same room. He raises his arms, moves his hands rhythmically, and turns his body with focused concentration. His movements are slightly uncoordinated but show determined effort. The camera remains steady as he performs various hand gestures and footwork against the backdrop of the sofa and toys. (3) The scene cuts to a well-lit public event venue with a small wooden stage. The boy is now wearing a bright yellow short-sleeved shirt over a blue t-shirt and black shorts. He stands confidently on the stage in front of a large vertical banner that displays his own portrait. Several adults and a girl in a school uniform are visible in the background, preparing for the event. (4) A large crowd of fans, primarily young women, is kneeling or sitting on the floor in front of the stage. They are all pointing their smartphones at the boy to record his performance. The boy dances with significantly more confidence and energy than in his home practice, executing rhythmic turns and hand movements in front of the audience. (5) The boy completes his performance and is joined on stage by a girl in a plaid skirt. The crowd claps and cheers enthusiastically while continuing to record with their phones. The boy smiles and interacts with the people around him. The camera pans across the dense crowd to show the scale of the attendance. (6) In the final segment, the camera captures a close-up of the boy standing on the edge of the stage. He looks slightly overwhelmed but happy as he interacts with an adult male voice from off-camera. The lighting remains bright and professional throughout the event hall.
